Waikīkī and the Ala Wai, built out

Every planned block is built out with a podium with shops and lobbies at street level and homes lining the streets above. Structured parking, about one stall per home, fills the block behind them, topped by an amenity deck with a pool; the street-facing homes rise three floors above the deck. Towers rise from the block corners, with more along the long edges where needed, no more than 5 feet behind the podium face. Floor area shifts toward Skyline stations, so towers are tallest near them; across all blocks it still averages the plan's FAR of 10. Towers step up near stations. Schools are sized for their enrollment, with gyms and, at Kaimuki High, an auditorium.
